spec_match.rationale: Implements real pagination over a live store with getAllRecords({query, count, direction}) against the cursor fallback, surfacing the {key, primaryKey, value} record shape and the cursor-free reverse read the feature exists for.

interactive.rationale: Seed, load, prev/next paging, direction and method selects, live timing bars and an event log — every control was driven in this session and behaved.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede's promise (paginated reader, forward/reverse paging, timing comparison) is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported-browser fallback and empty-page rows are handled; reseeding twice within the same second silently reuses the old data (the timestamp-second DB version collides), and the offset simulation over-fetches offset+pageSize records by design without noting the cost on deep pages.

references.rationale: After the 2026-10-18 fix the page links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5124331450138624 (it previously lacked the mandatory ChromeStatus link — invariant 3).

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite probes the real surface; untouched (immutable).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Cloud-fallback verification, NOT chrome-devtools-mcp (auto-research.md §0 blocker applies): headless Chromium 141 + raw CDP on a fresh profile — initial probe now reads supported on load; Seed wrote 200 records and enabled Load; page 1 showed rows 1–20 with live timings (11.8ms vs 4.5ms bars); Next advanced to rows 21–40; direction 'prev' re-read page 1 as keys 200…; cursor bar renders rose (209,26,42) vs emerald getAllRecords bar; screenshot read; console clean. Pre-fix evidence captured the broken state (seed hung, probe stuck at 'Checking…', both bars emerald).

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, keyboard operable, disabled states expressed natively; but the event log, timing readouts and page info are not live regions, so paging results are visual-only for screen readers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v133/indexeddb-getallrecords-and-direction-option-for-getall-getallkeys --merge passes desktop and mobile, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean (sub-44px advisory on compact nav buttons).

openQuestions.title: Announce paging results and log entries to screen readers
openQuestions.detail: Give #pageInfo (or the event log) role=status / aria-live=polite so 'Page 2 of 10' and seed confirmations are announced after each action.

openQuestions.title: Reseeding within the same second silently no-ops
openQuestions.detail: openDB uses Math.floor(Date.now()/1000) as the DB version, so two seeds inside one second produce the same version, skip upgradeneeded, and keep the old rows while the UI claims a fresh seed. Use a monotonically increasing version (e.g. current version + 1 read from the open) instead.

openQuestions.title: Note the over-fetch cost of offset simulation
openQuestions.detail: The getAllRecords path fetches count: offset+pageSize and slices, which is honest but increasingly expensive on deep pages; a line of copy (or a keyset-pagination variant using IDBKeyRange.lowerBound(lastKey, true)) would teach the production-grade pattern the record shape enables.

summary: Weekly hardening pass 2026-10-18 (headless Chromium 141 + raw CDP cloud fallback on a fresh profile, not chrome-devtools-mcp): found and fixed a broken primary action — the on-load connection had no onversionchange handler, so Seed's versioned open blocked forever (observed pre-fix: probe stuck at 'Checking…', Load never enabled). Fixes, smallest-patch: onversionchange=close on every connection plus an onblocked message; probeAPI now probes IDBObjectStore.prototype.getAllRecords directly (the store-transaction probe falsely reported 'not available' on a fresh profile — the false-support-probe anti-regression case); probe runs on load; duplicate style attribute on the cursor timing bar restored to rose; .log-err class defined; mandatory ChromeStatus link added. Post-fix CDP evidence: seed 200 rows, page 1 rows 1–20, Next → 21–40, direction prev → keys 200-descending, rose vs emerald bars, clean console. responsive-check passes both classes.
